patch_description: This rewrite uses a broader unrestricted deterministic restart portfolio before exact constrained polishing. It combines Gaussian configurations, staggered-ring configurations, and perturbed icosahedral twelve-point arrangements with two independently placed points. A batched smooth continuation efficiently identifies promising contact graphs, while final SLSQP epigraph solves directly minimize the squared diameter subject to all squared pair distances being at least one. The final selection is always made using the evaluator’s exact squared min/max ratio, not the surrogate objective.
